problem: “Castle Spire” reads like a pulled-out part of a building. A fixed architectural fragment is weak as a standalone hero object unless it is presented as a complete structure in its real environment.
fix: Changed it to a complete fantasy castle tower with doorway, roof and pennants, still shown in the bright castle courtyard environment.

problem: The surface is an outdoor festival market stall, but the background treatment says “festival village interior,” which contradicts the set place.
fix: Kept the cloak on the wooden market stall table and changed the cat3 background to a neutral plain wall with light glow.

problem: The set name “Moonlit Oath” suggests night, while the rules require a bright daytime or golden-hour mood.
fix: Renamed the variant to “Beacon Oath” and softened the motif to a bright crescent-leaf decorative silhouette.

problem: C6 and C7 were both equipment cards next to each other, breaking the class-diversity rule. The wand also felt like a replaceable catalogue magic item.
fix: Replaced the wand with a mythic golden apple from the enchanted orchard: a food/nature object that belongs to this exact noon moment and gives the route a stronger day-story beat.
